top_signals.title: MI5 warns UK academics have been aiding Chinese spies
top_signals.summary: Chinese intelligence tried to “covertly benefit” from British AI and technology research, security minister Dan Jarvis has warned, after MI5 accused a Beijing-linked institute of using UK academics to boost its spying capabilities. Britain’s domestic intelligence agency said more than 100 UK-linked academics had contributed to projects funded by the China General Technology Research Institute [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: RBC Says 30-Year Treasury Yield at 6% Is Possible
top_signals.summary: Rufaro Chiriseri, head of fixed income for Europe at RBC Wealth Management, discusses the outlook for Treasury yields and Federal Reserve policy. "6% on the on the 30-year is not a level that seems to be wildly out of any possibility," Chiriseri tells Bloomberg Television. "We still expect that yields could still continue to trend higher from here." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Fed Votes to Overhaul Stress Tests in Win for Big Banks
top_signals.summary: The Federal Reserve voted to finalize its stress test changes in a major victory for Wall Street’s lending giants.
